name: Soil
overview: Scripture presents soil both as a physical element affected by humanity's fall into sin and as a spiritual metaphor for how individuals receive God's word. In Genesis 3:17, the ground is cursed because of Adam's disobedience, symbolizing the hardship and toil that result from sin. In the parables recorded in Matthew 13, Jesus illustrates different responses to the gospel by comparing hearts to various types of soil—some unfruitful, others fruitful—highlighting the importance of understanding and embracing God's word to bear lasting spiritual fruit.
